messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate on /v1/generate across hosted-us-west-1. 5xx rate spike 08:12 UTC, 72% errors over 5m. Paging @taylor (oncall) and @maria (serving).

 taylor (oncall): acked. I'm looking at dashboards now. can someone drop the recent rollout config?

 maria (serving): pulling it up — we pushed a canary rollout 90m ago: model: text-redwood-v2, policy: canary(5%), region-weight: us-west primary, fallback-policy: smart-route. I see canary instances showing lots of 422/500 and latency skyrocketing.

 elaine (sre): logs show model server failing during init on canary pods in us-west-2 with "model variant mismatch" errors: "requested variant 'v2-8q' not found for image". Then requests get rerouted.

 prashant (platform): that explains a loop I see in routing traces — smart-router tries canary -> fails -> fallback region eu-west -> because eu-west capacity is low, it then routes back to canary in us-west (sticky fallback ttl 30s) which immediately errors again. loop repeats.

 taylor (oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) pause canary rollout, 2) force-route user traffic to stable variant, 3) remove sticky fallback ttl so we don't bounce. Who can pause the rollout?

 maria (serving): I can pause via the rollout API. running: 
```
POST /api/rollouts/12345/pause
{"reason":"canary failing - model-variant mapping bug"}
```
 responding... paused. status: paused.

 deploy-bot: Rollout 12345 status -> PAUSED by maria at 08:25 UTC :white_check_mark:

 prashant (platform): modifying routing table: setting policy override for customer-tier=hosted to model:text-redwood-v1 stable and disabling smart-route fallbacks for 10m. applying now.

 elaine (sre): after override, 5xx rate dropping to 6% and p95 latency back to ~180ms. customers still seeing some errors due to in-flight requests.

 ryan (support): field reports: two paying customers (acme-inc, shoply) reported 502s and timeouts for ~12 minutes. CS sent apologies and temporary credits. I'll escalate if anything persists.

 taylor (oncall): root cause summary so far: canary config used incorrect model_variant mapping (v2 -> v2-8q) on us-west cluster where that variant wasn't uploaded. smart routing then tried cross-region fallback, but sticky fallback + low capacity produced a routing loop. result: high error rates and unstable responses for some traffic.

 maria (serving): digging into the rollout spec: snippet: 
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  variant: v2-8q  # expected v2-16q
fallback:
  strategy: smart-route
  sticky_ttl: 30s
```
Yep, typo in variant name. Canary instances pulled wrong artifact tag which doesn't exist on the node image set.

 prashant (platform): long-term fix ideas: 1) validate model_variant exists in target region before enabling canary; 2) make smart-router detect immediate model-not-found errors and bubble up fatal to stop fallback loops; 3) adjust sticky_ttl to exponential backoff instead of fixed.

 elaine (sre): immediate follow-ups: add an automated preflight that checks variant availability + a short-circuit that marks canary unhealthy on init failures. I'll file an urgent SRE task.

 taylor (oncall): customer impact note for post-incident report: affected hosted customers in us-west, transient errors 5-20 minutes depending on session. Severity: P1 for customers with SLAs (2 impacted), P2 for general.

 ryan (support): adding impacted customer list: acme-inc, shoply, demo-org-42 (low traffic). logged incidents and sent targeted emails.

 maria (serving): after rollback and override, canary pods in us-west show crashloop with model-not-found. I'll rebuild canary artifact and re-run canary in a dedicated batch with pinned variant names.

 prashant (platform): patch queued: add preflight check + routing cooldown. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/782 (wip).

 taylor (oncall): handoff - I'm on for another 15m then handing to elaine for ops follow-up. elaine, take over and confirm the PR and playbook updates?

 elaine (sre): taking over. I'll coordinate with platform and serving on postmortem and update on-call runbook. locking rollout config to require variant validation.

 maria (serving): quick note for root-cause analysis: why did smart-router vote to fallback to eu-west instead of immediate failure? traces show it treats "model-init" errors as transient and prefers region fallback. we should classify model-not-found as fatal.

 prashant (platform): agreed. change backlog: (a) classify init/notfound as fatal, (b) route to degrade-to-compatible-variant only when version-compatibility checks pass, (c) add metrics for fallback-loop-rate.

 elaine (sre): timeline snippet for postmortem: 08:12 incident-bot alert -> 08:14 taylor ack -> 08:25 rollout paused -> 08:30 routing override applied -> 08:38 errors under threshold -> 08:45 handoff to elaine.

 taylor (oncall): final: will open the postmortem draft and tag infra, serving, platform, and support. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

 elaine (sre): posting handoff summary in #incidents-links and adding runbook changes as RFC.

 deploy-bot: Note: Rollout 12345 remains PAUSED; CI build 902 bumped for canary artifact.

 maria (serving): follow-up TODOs I'm owning: rebuild artifact with correct variant, run isolated canary in dedicated capacity, update canary spec validation.

 ryan (support): follow-up: customer follow-ups sent, refunds processed for acme-inc and shoply.

 elaine (sre): marking thread for postmortem extraction. I'll attach logs and routing traces to the postmortem doc.

 taylor (oncall): handing off completely now. elaine is oncall. thanks everyone.

 elaine (sre): acknowledged, taking full ownership. closing pager. :white_check_mark:
